title: Savoy cabbage, barley and cavolo nero soup

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a whole food or a plain staple, and vegetable stock and tinned tomatoes are explicitly allowed.

supermarket.reason: Leeks, carrots, Savoy cabbage, cavolo nero, pearl barley and Cheddar are all everyday items at Tesco and similar shops.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a large pan, knife, board and grater, with simple softening and simmering.

works.reason: 150g barley simmered for about 40 minutes in 1.5l stock plus a tin of tomatoes gives a thick but still brothy soup that feeds four.

honest_times.reason: Chopping leeks, carrots, cabbage and cavolo plus 10 minutes of softening fits 25 minutes of prep, and the 30 plus 10 minute simmers match the 45 minutes of cook time.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the rosemary, is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: A hot barley and cabbage soup suits late January, and half a Savoy cabbage leads the title and the pot.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, plain British English that a beginner can follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Barley, plenty of vegetables and a little cheese make a filling, wholesome family soup.
